text:
Type: faux sheepskin rug
Use: softening a floor, chair or bench; bedroom, living room, children's room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, bohemian
Materials: soft curly faux fur, hide-shaped backing
Colors: light cool grey
Shape: organic sheepskin outline with rounded lobes, dense curly fur, small and soft, light visual weight
Feel: cosy, soft, snug, calm
Goes with: white walls, light wood, grey or white textiles, black accents; Scandinavian or Japandi bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: FRDRUP
product.description: The rug is super soft, warm and cosy. Ideal on the floor or draped across your favourite armchair.
